dg.title: Today's digest
dg.sub: What came in on a day, what the risk engine saw, and what waits for your OK. The engine reports and waits.

head.running: {n} had another order running, {dup} of those look like duplicates

wait.d: What the engine proposed and a person still has to decide, from any day. Open an order to decide it there.

gate.on: The gate is on: the engine holds nothing, puts nothing in one parcel and asks no advance by itself. Its holds wait here as proposals.
gate.off: The gate is off: the switches in Risk rules decide what the engine does by itself. Turn the gate on in the card below to make every engine hold wait for a person.

holds.d: The engine wanted to hold these. Open the order and press “Hold” or “Let it go”.

reviews.d: Orders the duplicate or risk rules sent to a person.

bundles.d: One person's orders that could go in one parcel.

blocks.line: {n} numbers proposed for the blocklist wait in Risk rules.
blocks.none: No number waits for the blocklist.

dg.more: Showing {shown} of {total}. Raise the most rows in the card below to see more.

card.h: The engine acts only with your OK
card.d: When on, the engine acts on nothing by itself: the duplicate check's, a risk level's and the blocklist's holds become proposed holds a person decides, “one parcel by itself” stays a proposal, and no advance is asked by itself, whatever those switches say.
card.gate: Make every engine action wait for a person
card.maxRows: Most rows each waiting list shows

dg.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change the risk rules can change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this meanwhile. The card now shows theirs; change it again if needed.
err.FORBIDDEN: You cannot change the risk rules.
err.forbidden: You cannot change the risk rules.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was saved; try again.
err.other: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved; try again.
